description: A burst's settings, as its Settings tab in the app shows them: how its variants are named, and for an older report's burst, how each variant's run updates its file, what it does with empty charts, how it archives and how its filters match. Its folders and schedules are set in the app.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: getBurstSettings
title: Get burst settings
